title: Milestone lists record what most children can do by an age
summary: A US public-health list says a developmental milestone is something most children, 75 percent or more, can do by a given age, and that the list is not a screening test.
body: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention 2-month milestone page says developmental milestones are things most children, 75 percent or more, can do by a certain age. The milestone index calls a first step, a first grin, and waving bye-bye examples of milestones, and it says children reach them in how they,,, act, and move. The same pages say the. Act Early. materials are not a substitute for standardized, validated developmental screening tools. This is the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention definition. Another country's list can use different items and ages. A missing item on the list is not, by itself, a diagnosis.
